Monitoring children's growth is vital for every health professional working with children. This app is made for professionals to be used on a daily basis. It is optimised for speed and reliability. 

***Choose from international references***
The free version includes WHO Growth Standards (ages 0-5). In the pro version (available as an in-app-purchase) you can choose from 18 different references including CDC and preterm data. 

***Correct for preterm birth***
The app supports correction for preterm birth. For children born preterm you can change between the corrected and the actual age on the tap of a button. 

***Calculate target height***
Use the Hermanussen formula to estimate target height and see the target height range in the height diagram. 

***Maintain a patient data base***
Store patients and add further measurements on other occasions. There is a search function to quickly find a stored patient. 

***Use imperial or metric units***
Global support for unit change.

***Export to pdf***
Export diagrams as pdf documents ready for use in your patient documentation.
